company_description: Booking Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides online and traditional travel and restaurant reservations and related services in the United States, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates Booking.com, which offers online accommodation reservations; and Priceline, which provides discount travel reservations services, as well as online accommodation, flight, rental car reservation services, vacation packages, cruises, activity, and affiliate programs. It also operates Agoda that offers online accommodation reservation, flight, ground transportation, and attractions. In addition, the company operates KAYAK, an online meta-search service that allows consumers to search and compare travel itineraries and prices; and OpenTable for booking online restaurant reservations, as well as reservation management services to restaurants. Further, it offers travel-related insurance products, payment facilitation, and restaurant management services to consumers, travel service providers, and restaurants; and advertising services. The company was formerly known as The Priceline Group Inc. and changed its name to Booking Holdings Inc. in February 2018. Booking Holdings Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut.

ai_product_examples: Gen AI features pour planification de voyage
revenue_by_customer_type.rationale: Booking Holdings opère un modèle entièrement B2B2C : 100% des revenus proviennent de commissions et facilitation de paiements auprès de prestataires de voyage (hôtels, compagnies aériennes, restaurants) qui sont ses clients professionnels directs. Les consommateurs finaux utilisent les plateformes mais ne sont pas des clients payants. L'IA générative est intégrée pour améliorer l'expérience consommateur et l'efficacité opérationnelle, mais ne constitue pas une activité de vente d'IA distincte.

revenue_by_segment.reason: Booking Holdings consolide ses 5 marques en un seul segment reportable (online travel).

L'intensité du langage est moyenne avec "peuvent attirer" et "réduire", traduisant une menace réelle mais non immédiate (Intensité moyenne). Le risque est nouveau par rapport à l'année précédente, reflétant l'émergence de l'IA générative (Trend : nouveau). La catégorie Concurrence a un poids moyen en matière de risque stratégique (Weight : moyen), ce qui explique un score modéré de 3 sur 5.

La catégorie Technologie a un poids moyen en matière de risque (Weight : moyen), ce qui explique un score global de 3 sur 5.
